notes: Submode codes: LOC local bus, LRF light rail+ferry (shared skim), EXP express bus, HVY heavy rail (BART), COM commuter rail (Caltrain).
Transit times in skims are minutes x100 and divided by 100 in the UEC; IVT is entered as c_ivt*TOTIVT plus (c_ivt_<mode>-c_ivt)*KEYIVT, i.e. the mode factor applies only to time on the key mode.
Initial wait: c_shortiWait applies to the first waitThresh (10) minutes, c_longiWait to wait beyond 10 minutes.
Walk mode: c_walkTimeShort on walk time up to walkThresh miles, c_walkTimeLong beyond; bike similar with bikeThresh.
Taxi/TNC wait time enters as c_ivt*1.5*wait (rows 'Taxi - Wait time').
c_cost = (0.60*c_ivt)/valueOfTime: valueOfTime is the person's VOT in 2000$/hour, so c_cost is per 2000-cent (0.6 = 60 min/hr / 100 cents/$).
costPerMile 18.29 in the xls is a placeholder; RuntimeConfiguration.py overwrites it with AutoOpCost from params.properties (15.44 for 2023, see costs.auto_operating_cost).

Transit hesitance rows use c_ivt*%Work_Transit_Hesitance% etc.; values resolved here with the RTP2025 2023 params (Work 55, NonWork 0, Rail 108 IVT-minutes). These are post-2020 calibration adjustments for PBA50+.

units.c_*: utility per minute (time) or per unit as described; cost per 2000 cent

tm2py_crowding_function.formula: seated_cap = seats*period_min/headway; seated_pax=min(V,seated_cap); standing_pax=max(V-seated_cap,0); seated_cost = min_seat+(max_seat-min_seat)*(V/capacity)^power_seat; standing_cost = min_stand+(max_stand-min_stand)*(V/capacity)^power_stand; crowded_cost=(seated_cost*seated_pax+standing_cost*standing_pax)/(V+0.01); IVT multiplier added = max(crowded_cost-1,0)
tm2py_crowding_function.capacity_definition: capacity = total (seated+standing) vehicle capacity over the period

eawt_extra_added_wait_time.form: eawt = const + w1*(1/headway) + w2*(V/cap) + w3*(offs_through_segment/total_offs), multiplied by mode eawt_factor

tm2py_crowding_function.note: Docstring says the form follows a Toronto (Emme) implementation.

rail.note: planning capacity 3.7 sq ft/standee; crowding capacity 2.7 sq ft/standee; load factor = passengers/seats

bus.note: average max load 4.5 sq ft/standee; crowding capacity 3.0 sq ft/standee

mtc_transitSeatCap.note: LRVn = n-car Muni Metro train (per car 119 total / 60 seats). 'Caltrain PCEP' = electrified (Stadler KISS) set. BART per-car implied ~111 total / 55 seats (10-car).

Very low vs $2.85 posted fare because of free youth/passes/transfers counted as unlinked trips and SFMTA's NTD fare allocation (identical $0.50 across modes suggests allocation by trips). Use with caution.

operating_cost_ntd.note: NTD rail VRH are counted per car, so LR/HR/CR cost per hour is per car-hour, not per train-hour. 2024 SFMTA UPT: MB 77.86M, TB 46.45M, LR 28.23M, SR 3.83M, CC 3.93M. SRTP FY19-30 reports Muni cost per revenue hour $220.39 (FY2017 baseline, nominal) as a cross-check (source sfmta_srtp).

HBO_plus_HBSOCREC.note: derived here: rate-weighted combination of NHTS TRIPPURP HBO (excluding home<->school trips, split out above) and HBSOCREC

trip_generation.nhts_method: Weekday (TDWKND=02) trips; trips/person = sum(trip weight)/(365*5/7)/sum(person weight). 2017: HH_CBSA=41860 (San Francisco-Oakland-Hayward MSA, includes CA add-on sample), WTTRDFIN/WTPERFIN. 2022: MSACAT=01 (MSA >=1M with rail; national, no CBSA in public file), WTTRDFIN5D/WTPERFIN5D. Purpose = NHTS TRIPPURP (HBW, HBSHOP, HBSOCREC, HBO, NHB); for 2017 home<->school trips (WHYFROM/WHYTO in {01,02} with 08) are split from HBO by respondent age (<18 K-12, else university). Period = STRTTIME hour mapped to TM1 periods. from_home_share = share of trips in that period departing home (WHYFROM 01/02), usable as P->A direction factor. Lengths: weighted means of TRPMILES / TRVLCMIN (non-negative). Computed by scratchpad script; output also in data/beta3/raw/params/nhts_derived_summary.json.
